---
name: internal-comms
description: Write a factual workplace update, brief or incident report.
license: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.txt
---

Adapted for MuseOrg from the pinned Anthropic skill identified in the bundle manifest.

Identify the audience and purpose. Use the user's existing format when one is
supplied; otherwise lead with the outcome and give only the decisions, evidence,
blockers and next actions that audience needs. Do not invent company conventions.

Gather authorized messages, calendar items, files, task events and artifacts that
bear on the request. Keep source references so another coworker can verify the
brief. Resolve current project facts against the latest revision before using
older memories. Distinguish an estimate, a proposal and a completed operation.

For an incident, state the observed symptom, affected behavior, confirmed cause,
repair and verification. For progress, state what changed and what remains blocked.
An attempted command, staged action or pending deployment is not completion.

Preserve private conversation boundaries. Include only the context needed by the
recipient, never credentials or unrelated personal details. Draft in the current
conversation or an artifact; sending elsewhere uses an authorized connection and
its actual approval/scope requirements.
